newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti new board members from finance world.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti new board members from finance world.

text.p: The two new board members Olivetti intends to coopt in coming weeks will be "exponents of the international financial community" an Olivetti official said on Friday.

The official said the new board members would not be direct representatives of the international institutional investors who currently hold more 70 percent of the company's stock. "We are talking about exponents of the international financial community," the official said.
Fund managers have been pressing in recent weeks for places on the board of the troubled company to represent their interests.
